sentences.zh: 今年我对待健康的方式有了很大的改变。

sentences.en: I used to be really focused on maximizing and doing more.
sentences.zh: 我以前非常专注于追求极致和做更多的事情。

sentences.zh: 而现在我终于意识到，如果我倾听身体的需求，我的表现反而会好得多。

sentences.en: And I love opening my WHOOP app and seeing how my sleep, my stress, my strain is correlating with my mood, with my running performance, with how I'm just feeling day-to-day.

sentences.en: I'm not an elite athlete by any means, but I do really benefit.
sentences.zh: 我绝对算不上什么顶级运动员，但我确实受益匪浅。

sentences.en: And I also just really enjoy knowing more about my body.
sentences.zh: 而且我也真的很享受去更多地了解自己的身体。

sentences.en: And WHOOP also gives me these actionable, personalized insights that have made me more intentional and meant that I make smarter decisions day-to-day about what I need
sentences.zh: WHOOP还为我提供这些切实可行、个性化的洞察，让我更有意识，这意味着我在日常生活中能对自己的需求做出更明智的决定，

sentences.zh: 而不是像踩着油门那样一味地盲目前行、不停地死磕。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《二十几岁的心态》（The Psychology of Your 20s），这是一个我们探讨二十几岁时的一些重大生活变化与过渡，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及它们对我们心理意味着什么的播客。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目中。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here back for another episode as we, of course, break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 新听众、老听众，无论你身处世界的哪个角落，非常高兴你能回来收听新的一期节目，当然，我们将在这里剖析二十几岁的心态。

sentences.en: A subject I'd like to talk about a lot is agency and the fact that I think in about 80% of instances in our lives, we get to control our reality and what we're experiencing.
sentences.zh: 我经常想聊的一个主题是自主权，事实上我认为在我们生活中大约80%的情况下，我们是可以掌控自己的现实和正在经历的事情的。

sentences.en: I think so much about how we operate and how we function, our daily lives is actually within our power.
sentences.zh: 我常常觉得，我们的运作和行事方式，以及我们的日常生活，其实都在我们的掌控之中。

sentences.en: But a lot of us choose to live quite passively and we let things happen to us rather than actively choosing who we are, our outlook, our experiences, our behaviours,
sentences.zh: 但我们当中许多人选择过一种相当被动的生活，我们任由事情发生在自己身上，而不是积极主动地去选择我们是谁、我们的视野、我们的经历、我们的行为，

sentences.en: who we spend time with.
sentences.zh: 以及我们和谁在一起。

sentences.en: We say it all the time on the podcast, but I think sometimes the easiest and most convenient choice is not always the best for you.
sentences.zh: 我们在播客里经常这么说，但我认为有时候最简单、最省事的选择并不总是对你最好的。

sentences.en: And this is especially important to recognise in our 20s when we are at such a formative juncture and in the midst of really deciding what we want long-term,
sentences.zh: 在我们的二十几岁，当我们处于这样一个具有塑造性的关键时期，正处于真正决定我们长期想要什么、

sentences.en: what we want with our careers, with our health, with our finances.
sentences.zh: 在职业、健康和财务上想要什么的时候，这一点尤为重要。

sentences.en: I don't think that we can actually afford to be passive.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们实际上经不起被动。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean that we have to be constantly kind of finding for the next big thing and overworking ourselves.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着我们必须不断地去寻找下一个重大机遇并过度透支自己。

sentences.en: We don't always have to be focused on achievement, but I think more so that we need some kind of structure to how we think about our future, but also about our present
sentences.zh: 我们不必总是把重点放在成就上，但我认为更重要的是，我们需要为如何思考我们的未来，以及我们的现在，

sentences.en: and what kind of life we are creating for ourselves.
sentences.zh: 以及我们正在为自己创造什么样的生活建立某种结构。

sentences.en: And I thought, who better to bring on for this episode than the wonderful hosts of Girls With Goals to have kind of a discussion and informative conversation
sentences.zh: 我想，还有谁比《目标女孩》（Girls With Goals）的精彩主持人们更适合来参加这一期节目呢，我们可以进行一场探讨与交流，

sentences.en: on how not to be passive when it comes to creating a happy and fulfilling life.
sentences.zh: 讨论在创造幸福且充实的生活时如何避免被动。

sentences.en: So, Carolyn and Catherine, welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 那么，卡洛琳（Carolyn）和凯瑟琳（Catherine），欢迎来到节目。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我们来。

sentences.en: I'm Carolyn.
sentences.zh: 我是卡洛琳。

sentences.en: I'm Ann Catherine.
sentences.zh: 我是安·凯瑟琳（Ann Catherine）。

sentences.en: We are, we're twin sisters.
sentences.zh: 我们是，我们是一对双胞胎姐妹。

sentences.en: We're based in Boston in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们常驻在美国波士顿，

sentences.en: and we host the show Girls With Goals.
sentences.zh: 我们是节目《目标女孩》的主持人。

sentences.en: We talk so much on our show about health and wellness, but mostly in the sense of how it fits into our lifestyles and ultimately building your own most confident life,
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中经常谈论健康与养生，但主要是从它如何融入我们的生活方式以及最终构建你最自信的生活的角度出发，

sentences.en: however that's going to look.
sentences.zh: 无论这种生活最终会是什么样子。

sentences.en: And, you know, every topic we dive into is something that we're actively navigating at the same time.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们深入探讨的每一个话题，都是我们同时也在积极应对的事情。

sentences.en: And I think figuring out how to have that right balance of control over your lives while at the same time being kind of trusting in the path and not trying to get
sentences.zh: 我认为，如何在对生活保持恰当控制与同时对道路保持某种信任、不试图在掌控上变得

sentences.en: too overwhelmed with the control is something that we're always working to figure out.
sentences.zh: 过于不堪重负之间找到正确的平衡，是我们一直在努力摸索的事情。

sentences.en: So, I think hopefully we'll be able to come and bring some good advice on how to stop being passive in your life and take more control without it being too overwhelming
sentences.zh: 所以，我希望我们能带一些好的建议来，关于如何停止生活中的被动，并在不把担子背得太沉重的前提下掌控更多主动权，

sentences.en: of a feat to take on.
sentences.zh: 不会觉得这是一件让人难以承受的壮举。

sentences.en: Yeah, I love the word control in a good way is what we're getting at here.
sentences.zh: 对，我喜欢“掌控”这个词，我们这里指的是积极意义上的掌控。

sentences.en: Control as in you're in the power of your life, which I think is really important when we're talking about whether or not you're living passively.
sentences.zh: 掌控意味着你掌握着自己生活的主动权，我认为这在我们讨论你是否在过一种被动的生活时真的很重要。

sentences.en: So, we love, you know, like Caroline said, this is a time that we're navigating actively ourselves and that's what we talk about.
sentences.zh: 所以，正如卡洛琳所说，我们很喜欢这个话题，这是我们自己正在积极经历的一段时期，这也是我们所谈论的内容。

sentences.en: So, you know, we're working on trying not to be passive or being aware of that and knowing how to be confident within that and, you know, actively work towards moving away
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们正努力试着不去被动，或者意识到这一点，并知道如何在其中保持自信，你知道的，积极努力地摆脱

sentences.en: from passive life and taking more control and feeling empowered in our lives is what we talk about all the time.
sentences.zh: 被动的生活，掌握更多的主动权，在生活中感到充满力量，这就是我们一直在谈论的。

sentences.en: So, this is a really great episode.
sentences.zh: 所以，这真的是非常棒的一期节目。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我们做客。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: Well, I feel like that's something I really admire about you guys.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得这也是我非常佩服你们的地方。

sentences.en: Firstly, you're in your 20s, which I think is like obviously the psychology of your 20s.
sentences.zh: 首先，你们正值二十几岁，我认为这显然就是《二十几岁的心态》。

sentences.en: Like, I like talking to people who also kind of get it, but I really admire how you're both like quite intentional in how you live, right?
sentences.zh: 就像，我喜欢和那些同样能心领神会的人交谈，但我真的很佩服你们俩在生活方式上都相当有目标感，对吧？

sentences.en: You really like prioritize the good parts of life as much as you can, even when it's difficult.
sentences.zh: 你们尽可能地优先考虑生活中美好的一面，即使在困难的时候也是如此。

sentences.en: Like, you guys are full-time students.
sentences.zh: 比如，你们俩都是全职学生。

sentences.en: You're running your own businesses.
sentences.zh: 你们还在经营自己的生意。

sentences.en: When it comes to that, what do you think it means to be intentional, especially when we have like so many other things on our plate that can make it really difficult
sentences.zh: 说到这里，你们觉得有目标感意味着什么，尤其是当我们焦头烂额有那么多其他事情要做，这可能会让人很难

sentences.en: to focus on bringing, like, I feel like being intentional sometimes gets compared to putting in more effort, right?
sentences.zh: 专注于去带来……我觉得有目标感有时会被拿来与付出更多努力相比较，对吧？

sentences.en: And having to give more energy when you don't actually have it.
sentences.zh: 并且在实际上并没有那么多精力时不得不付出更多精力。

sentences.en: But what does it mean for you guys?
sentences.zh: 但对你们俩来说，这究竟意味着什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's definitely not just straight up putting in more energy.
sentences.zh: 对，这绝对不仅仅是单纯地付出更多精力。

sentences.en: And I think we've all been there where that is our default because it's the simplest, seemingly simplest solution before you actually, you know, try out some solutions.
sentences.zh: 我想我们都经历过那种把这当作默认选择的情况，因为在你在真正尝试某些解决方案之前，这是最简单、看似最简单的解决方法。

sentences.en: It's kind of our default, our go-to.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是我们的默认模式，我们的首选。

sentences.en: Just if things aren't working out or they're not working out as you want them to, just throw more effort in.
sentences.zh: 如果事情进展不顺利，或者没有按照你想要的方式发展，那就索性付出更多的努力。

sentences.en: Like, do more things.
sentences.zh: 比如做更多的事情。

sentences.en: Work harder.
sentences.zh: 更努力地工作。

sentences.en: Not the answer all the time because that almost pushes you further into that, you know, passiveness.
sentences.zh: 但这并不总是解决问题的办法，因为那几乎会把你进一步推向那种，你知道的，被动状态。

sentences.en: Anytime I've felt like I'm in a state of passiveness,
sentences.zh: 每当我感觉自己处于一种被动状态时，

sentences.en: first of all, I don't realize it until like a month or two or even more down the line.
sentences.zh: 首先，我往往直到一两个月甚至更久之后才意识到这一点。

sentences.en: And I'm like, oh my God,
sentences.zh: 然后我会想，天哪，

sentences.en: I've been living on autopilot.
sentences.zh: 我一直都在自动驾驶模式下生活。

sentences.en: Like, I couldn't even tell you what happened these past four months.
sentences.zh: 比如，我甚至都说不出过去这四个月发生了什么。

sentences.en: But having the, you know, ability to acknowledge that and pull yourself out of that is a really intentional thing.
sentences.zh: 但拥有承认这一点并把自己拉出来的能力，是一件非常有目标感的事情。

sentences.en: And it's not to say that you're never going to have times of feeling passive or, you know, that you have to throw yourself an autopilot.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说你永远不会经历感觉被动的时候，或者说你永远不会让自己进入自动驾驶模式。

sentences.en: But when you do notice it, being able to, you know, pull yourself out of it.
sentences.zh: 但当你注意到它时，你要有能力让自己摆脱出来。

sentences.en: And sometimes that means not throwing more, more gas on the fire, but taking a step back and going back to those foundations.
sentences.zh: 有时这意味着不要给火上浇油，而是退后一步，回归那些基础的事情。

sentences.en: And so knowing that there are a bunch of different options and that maybe not putting all your effort in and losing all of your steam and absolutely burning out is the best answer.
sentences.zh: 所以要明白其实有许多不同的选择，也许拼尽全力、耗尽所有精力并彻底精疲力竭并不是最好的答案。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's taking a step back and going back to your, you know, foundations, the things that you absolutely have to do.
sentences.zh: 有时我们需要退后一步，回归到你的基础，也就是那些你绝对必须要做的事情上。

sentences.en: Yeah, I totally agree.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全赞同。

sentences.en: I read this article actually like today by The Atlantic called like the status of being busy, which is that like in this day and age being busy is seen as like as being successful,
sentences.zh: 其实我今天刚读了《大西洋月刊》（The Atlantic）上的一篇文章，叫做“忙碌的状态”，大意是说在这个时代，忙碌被视为一种成功的象征、

sentences.en: as being popular, as being like a go-getter when actually
sentences.zh: 受欢迎的象征、积极进取的象征，而实际上，

sentences.en: busyness really just demonstrates, yes, obviously like a period of just having a lot on and chaos, but actually it represents an inability to set personal boundaries in a way
sentences.zh: 忙碌真正体现的，固然是一段焦头烂额、充满混乱的时期，但它实际上代表了一种无法设立个人界限的状态，

sentences.en: because you don't and you haven't been intentional in putting time aside, right?
sentences.zh: 因为你没有，而且你也没有有意识地留出时间，对吧？

sentences.en: I think you made a really good point.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你提出了一个很好的观点。

sentences.en: Like we talk about not being passive.
sentences.zh: 就像我们谈论不要被动一样。

sentences.en: Not being passive doesn't mean
sentences.zh: 不被动并不意味着

sentences.en: being active, right?
sentences.zh: 要积极，对吧？

sentences.en: Like you would think that that's the opposite, right?
sentences.zh: 你会觉得那是对立面，对吧？

sentences.en: Okay, if I don't want to be passive, I better be doing things all the time, but it's actually being intentional.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果我不想被动，那我最好无时无刻不在做事，但实际上这是要有目标感。

sentences.en: It's actually being like, okay, wait, is this really,
sentences.zh: 实际上是去想，好吧，等等，这真的是——

sentences.en: I think I really liked the example of you being like, okay, feeling the need to spend every single night with friends, feeling the need to go out, to go out to dinner.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我真的很喜欢你举的那个例子，比如：觉得有必要每天晚上都和朋友在一起，觉得有必要出门，去外面吃晚餐。

sentences.en: That is the easiest thing because saying yes is the easiest thing, but saying no is the hard thing and it's sometimes the right thing.
